verdict.rationale: Gitleaks supports background automation via gitleaks-action (auto-runs on every push/PR, PR comments, Slack/GitHub alerts) and via pre-commit hooks that trigger on every commit, satisfying the 'runs autonomously without manual invocation' aspect. However this is CI/git-event-triggered automation, not an AI-agent-style scheduler, and there's no evidence of cron-like standalone daemon mode, webhook/queue integration, or agent-framework hooks. Missing for 10: standalone scheduled/daemon automation independent of git hooks or CI triggers, and any explicit AI-agent orchestration support.
